body:
Founder ran sudo-queue/32-restart-iduna-for-portal-local-login.sh as fatbaby -- iduna.service restarted onto the rebuilt binary carrying S203-01's real POST /portal/login. Verified end-to-end post-restart: login sets a real HttpOnly iduna_session cookie (JWT includes devportal.access), and GET /portal with that cookie renders the actual tool list (Jupyter/JEWEL + SARENA_NOTEBOOK) instead of bouncing to login. S201-03's original access-control gate, dead since 2026-08-25 for lack of any real grant path, is now actually passable via the local_users login.

⚓ ☃
title: Portal local-login deployed and verified live
